setupCorrections.detail: The first fixture run set restrictToolNames true, which intentionally omitted caller inline extensions and left the observer unbound. The final run used the public full-factory path with restrictToolNames false, disabled ambient discovery, and kept write/bash as the requested tools.

The first interactive fixture UI omitted the public setWidget method and produced autoresearch extension UI errors. The final fixture supplied the supported setWidget surface; all final runtimeErrors arrays were empty.

An interim cancellation fixture threw from ExtensionUIContext.select. That exercised injected UI-error handling rather than the supported selector cancellation result. The final fixture returns undefined from select, matching the public cancellation seam.

limits: This is one Linux x64 run of the installed public SDK against a controlled loopback model; it proves the exercised factory and built-in permission seams, not external provider availability or credential conversion.
The controlled UI select implementation is a disposable public ExtensionUIContext fixture. It does not prove a Host or terminal UI rendering integration.
Approval events expose presence and boolean outcome only; raw reasons, IDs, prompt text, arguments, paths and responses were not retained.

The result closes the reachable full-factory interactive permission evidence gap for this M0 slice, but M0 remains blocked on maintainer-owned provider/OAuth conversion feasibility and non-Linux/macOS worker-resource decisions.
